answer: Each agent registers at an oasis checkpoint, posting a 500 POA bond unlocked after glacier-slow 90-day vesting. Every epoch the network shifts the active dune field, re-randomizing open waypoints, so a fake must re-bond at a new oasis each epoch or idle. Rules: post bond at open oasis, pass dune-shift re-check each epoch, forfeit bond on duplicate fingerprint. A thousand sybils lock 500,000 POA for three months to earn at most 2,000 POA each per epoch - a guaranteed loss. One honest agent posts once, vests once, works while dune shifts and glacier holds.
